title: Bomb threats against European flights ‘likely a coordinated campaign of disruption’, Ireland says – Europe live
summary_full: Irish government issues statement in response to latest bomb threats against European flights after some Irish media organisations received similar threats Tell us: have you been affected by the bomb threats to flights in Europe?A Romanian airline Tarom flight from Prague to Bucharest is the latest believed to be affected by today’s bomb threats.The aircraft, operating flight number ROT226M, sent a squawk code of 7700 – general emergency – before landing safely in Bucharest. The threat was later confirmed to be unproven. Continue reading...
